web_user.description: System user account under which the server runs (must exist on system).

web_group.description: System group for the server process (must exist on system).

port.description: TCP port to listen on (set to 0 to disable the listener; use 443 for HTTPS).

host.description: IP address or hostname to bind to (empty = all local interfaces).

document_root.description: Absolute path to the directory served as the website root.

cgidir.description: Absolute path to the directory containing server-wide CGI scripts (empty = disable CGI).

userdir.description: Relative or absolute path for per-user CGI/home directories under user homes (empty = disable per-user CGI).

default_index.description: Comma-separated list of filenames to use as directory index files.

access_log_path.description: Path to access log file (empty = disable access logging).

error_log_path.description: Path to error log file (empty = disable error logging).

max_connections.description: Maximum concurrent connections (0 = use system default).

timeout_seconds.description: Request timeout in seconds (0 = no timeout).

enable_cgi.description: Enable execution of CGI scripts (requires 'cgidir' to be set).

enable_directory_listing.description: Enable automatic directory listing when no index file exists.

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to TLS certificate file (required if SSL is enabled).

ssl_key_path.description: Path to TLS private key file (required if SSL is enabled).

ssl_protocols.description: List of allowed TLS protocol versions.

mime_types.description: Additional file extension → MIME type mappings (e.g., '.webp=image/webp).

virtual_hosts.description: List of virtual host definitions (only used if 'enable_vhosts' is true).

port.description: Port for this host (optional; overrides global port).

ssl.description: Enable SSL for this host (overrides global ssl).

certfile.description: Certificate path for this host (required if SSL).

keyfile.description: Private key path for this host (required if SSL).

cgi_env.description: Environment variables passed to CGI scripts (e.g., 'PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin').
